title: One A-A pair, released at rest, traced for 100 time units across the whole chamber
pitch: Two A particles released at rest at r0=3, traced for T=100 at dt=0.05. The pair falls together, so the record covers close approach and wall rebounds: the regime where constant-K windows fail (P-0022 used T<=0.8; P-0025 excludes r<4). Test: one K and one exponent P must fit the whole record at noise level (chi2/n near 1). Falsifier: no single P in 2.0 to 2.7 fits the full record with chi2/n below 3, which would mean the power-law form fails below r=4.
